disclosed_but_outside_architecture_claim.rule: Missing or partial domain datasets remain visible in outputs and residue ledgers but do not fail the architecture claim when the architecture correctly preserves and quarantines that incompleteness.
Stale or point-in-time upstream domain feeds remain disclosed but are not evidence that the federation architecture itself is invalid.

Domain records in needs_review/blocked state may remain non-promotable data; architecture certification requires that their state is preserved and cannot be silently promoted, not that every domain record is adjudicated.

A null source_hash allowed by the producer source-manifest schema remains disclosed. Architecture certification covers integrity of the emitted runtime and control-plane bytes, not a claim that every upstream service exposes retrievable immutable raw bytes.

promotion_rule: Only zero blocking residue permits FEDERATION_SPATIAL_ARCHITECTURE certification. Nonblocking domain residue must remain present in the evidence package and must never be rewritten as resolved.
